name: Israel
description: Israel is a unitary parliamentary republic in the Middle East known for its technology and defense sectors. Founded in 1948, it built a startup-nation economy on R&D intensity, venture capital and military-civilian technology transfer, alongside strengths in water, agriculture and diamonds. Regional conflict and disputed borders remain central to its political economy.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Israel's actor space from pre-state institutions and Histadrut enterprises through defense-led R&D to venture-backed technology firms, desalination utilities, and coalition parliamentary governance.

works.title: Startup and Defense Technology Network
works.description: Network analysis of military R&D spillovers, venture funds, multinational R&D centers and incubators binding Tel Aviv's ecosystem to Nasdaq exits.

works.title: Territorial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of districts, development towns, contested boundaries, and infrastructure arbitrating water, land and security.
